message.content:
Here are some top-rated sushi spots in Los Angeles that consistently receive rave reviews:

| Restaurant | Neighborhood | Highlights |
|------------|--------------|------------|
| **Sushi Gen** | Little Tokyo | Classic omakase, fresh fish, intimate setting |
| **KazuNori** | West Hollywood | Creative rolls, excellent service, great atmosphere |
| **Matsuhisa** | Beverly Hills | Chef Nobu’s flagship, high-end omakase experience |
| **Sushi Zo** | Downtown | Award‑winning omakase, meticulous presentation |
| **Umi** | West Hollywood | Contemporary take on traditional sushi, chic décor |

If you’re looking for a more casual or budget-friendly option, consider **Sushi Taro** (Hollywood) or **Sushi Katsu** (Beverly Grove). All of these places offer a range of experiences from classic to avant-garde, so pick one that matches your vibe!
